record_title: Exponential staging loss for incremental projection-DPP column selection
provenance: Analytic lower-bound construction for the conditional-DPP multi-stage adaptive randomized pivoting method of arXiv:2609.20556, compared with one-shot ARP and classical volume-sampling guarantees.
limitations: The family is adversarial and becomes ill-conditioned as its optimal rank-d tail singular value tends to zero. The theorem fixes d and takes an asymptotic hierarchy parameter to zero, treats the one-column-per-stage schedule only, and does not establish sharpness for arbitrary block schedules, average-case behavior, spectral-norm error, or finite-precision sampler stability.
